svg.title: A tree can only cut along the axes
svg.desc: Two scatter panels: on the left a diagonal class boundary approximated by an eight-step blue staircase of axis-aligned cuts, on the right the same points with the axes rotated so a single green vertical cut separates them, with depth-three tree accuracy rising from 0.9105 to 1.0000, above the Gini arithmetic for one split ending in a circled gain of 0.1250, a three-level tree whose leaves carry class counts, and two near-identical datasets differing by one flipped label growing visibly different trees.
svg.text: A tree can only cut along the axes
8 splits, and it still is not the line
16 leaves - it memorised the training rows
